title: Wishing Well
html:
Wishing Well

The Wishing Well is at the top of Townston, near the Loremaster. If you toss in King's Coins (1 if you're a member, 2 if you're not) it will give you something in return - usually something small (500-1500 Gold, a blue item, etc.) but occasionally something valuable such as a purple or even a rainbow. All items received from the Wishing Well are non-member, not soulbound, and at your current level. Ninja and Pirate items are only available from the Wishing Well.

The Well can be used once an hour. If it is available it will have an ! like a quest giver. If it is not, it will have nothing.
